messages.subject: Reminder: SRA competency CPD — AI & legal practice (15 Oct)
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello,

A reminder that the next CPD session, "Generative AI in legal practice: risks and opportunities", takes place on Wednesday 15 October at 12:30 in the Bishopsgate training room (lunch provided). One competency hour. Please register via the L&D portal if you'd like to attend.

Kind regards,
Learning & Development
